# Image optimization fixtures

The JPEG fixtures were generated from a synthetic pattern at quality 100. RGB, grayscale, and CMYK input are represented. A solid red image is stored in `cmyk.jpg` so channel inversion can be detected.

The PNG fixture was generated with a size of 64 × 64 pixels, red pixels, alpha 128, and optional `Description` metadata. Metadata retention and removal are tested separately.

All fixtures were generated for these tests. No external images or image-processing Python dependencies are required.
